instanceExperimental.appsDescription: Show the Apps navigation and allow access to app connections, gateways, and advanced app tooling.
instanceExperimental.autoRecoveryDescription: Let the heartbeat scheduler create recovery tasks for task dependency chains found inside the configured lookback window.
instanceExperimental.autoRestartDescription: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.
instanceExperimental.betaSkillsDescription: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Paperclip core skill. Disabling this returns every agent to the default live skill without removing saved pins.
instanceExperimental.builtInAgentsDescription: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.
instanceExperimental.casesDescription: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
instanceExperimental.casesFootnote: Turning Cases off hides the tab and blocks the case API; existing case data is kept.
instanceExperimental.classicTaskDescription: Restores the previous task detail page: the page-level header with inline description editing, the plain comment thread, and the fixed Properties sidebar. Chat-only features — streaming activity folding, inline plan and question cards, the three-mode composer — are unavailable in the classic view.
instanceExperimental.classicTaskFootnote: Switching takes effect immediately. No task data is affected.
instanceExperimental.classicTaskAriaLabel: Toggle classic task interface experimental setting
instanceExperimental.conferenceRoomDescription: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
instanceExperimental.conferenceRoomAriaLabel: Toggle conference room chat experimental setting
instanceExperimental.decisionsDescription: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces the tasks awaiting your input — while the surface is still being evaluated.
instanceExperimental.environmentsDescription: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.
instanceExperimental.externalObjectsDescription: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.
instanceExperimental.isolatedWorkspacesDescription: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.
instanceExperimental.fileViewerDescription: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.
instanceExperimental.goalsSidebarDescription: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.
instanceExperimental.goalsSidebarAriaLabel: Toggle goals sidebar link experimental setting
instanceExperimental.managedSandboxDescription: Hide the local environment and run all agents in the platform-managed sandbox environment.
instanceExperimental.managedSandboxAriaLabel: Toggle managed sandbox only experimental setting
instanceExperimental.worktreeDescription: This is an isolated git-worktree preview instance. Turn this on to let the scheduler execute runs here. Only tasks created after enabling will run automatically — copied/pre-existing tasks stay parked. Toggling off and on resets the cutoff.
instanceExperimental.worktreeMismatchReason: This setting was armed in a different instance and copied here, so no tasks run automatically.
instanceExperimental.worktreeMissingCutoffReason: This setting is missing its activation cutoff, so no tasks run automatically.
instanceExperimental.worktreeToggleHint: Toggle it off and back on to arm execution for tasks created here.
instanceExperimental.serverInfoDescription: Show a "Server" section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.
instanceExperimental.serverInfoAriaLabel: Toggle server info debug view experimental setting
instanceExperimental.simplifiedEnglishDescription: Instruct agents to write user interactions (plan confirmations, questions, suggested tasks, checkbox prompts) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with brief context on what information the decision needs and what happens for each choice.
instanceExperimental.simplifiedEnglishAriaLabel: Toggle simplified english interactions experimental setting
instanceExperimental.smokeLabDescription: Add a "Smoke Lab" tab under Apps → Developer and an "Integration smoke" card on the dashboard for exercising every integration path against deterministic local fixtures (fake OAuth provider + loopback MCP servers). Private (non-public) deployments only.
instanceExperimental.statusCardsDescription: Enable the experimental shared status-card board and its gated API. Existing card data is kept when this is disabled.
instanceExperimental.statusCardsFootnote: Enabling Status Cards also enables Summaries.
instanceExperimental.summariesDescription: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history. Existing summary data is kept when this is disabled.
instanceExperimental.summariesFootnote: Status Cards requires Summaries. Disabling Summaries also disables Status Cards.
instanceExperimental.planDecompositionDescription: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.
instanceExperimental.planDecompositionAriaLabel: Toggle task plan decomposition panel experimental setting
instanceExperimental.watchdogsDescription: Show task detail controls for configuring watchdog agents that verify stopped task subtrees and restore live paths when work should continue.

agentConfigHelp.name: Display name for this agent.
agentConfigHelp.title: Job title shown in the org chart.
agentConfigHelp.role: Organizational role. Determines position and capabilities.
agentConfigHelp.reportsTo: The agent this one reports to in the org hierarchy.
agentConfigHelp.capabilities: Describes what this agent can do. Shown in the org chart and used for task routing.
agentConfigHelp.adapterType: How this agent runs: local CLI (Claude/Codex/OpenCode), OpenClaw Gateway, spawned process, or generic HTTP webhook.
agentConfigHelp.cwd: Deprecated legacy working directory fallback for local adapters. Existing agents may still carry this value, but new configurations should use project workspaces instead.
agentConfigHelp.promptTemplate: Sent on every heartbeat. Keep this small and dynamic. Use it for current-task framing, not large static instructions. Supports {{ agent.id }}, {{ agent.name }}, {{ agent.role }} and other template variables.
agentConfigHelp.model: Override the default model used by the adapter.
agentConfigHelp.thinkingEffort: Control model reasoning depth. Supported values vary by adapter/model.
agentConfigHelp.chrome: Enable Claude's Chrome integration by passing --chrome.
agentConfigHelp.dangerouslySkipPermissions: Run unattended by auto-approving adapter permission prompts when supported.
agentConfigHelp.dangerouslyBypassSandbox: Run Codex without sandbox restrictions. Required for filesystem/network access.
agentConfigHelp.search: Enable Codex web search capability during runs.
agentConfigHelp.fastMode: Enable Codex Fast mode. This burns credits/tokens much faster and is supported on GPT-5.6, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, and manual Codex model IDs.
agentConfigHelp.workspaceStrategy: How Paperclip should realize an execution workspace for this agent. Keep project_primary for normal cwd execution, or use git_worktree for issue-scoped isolated checkouts.
agentConfigHelp.workspaceBaseRef: Base git ref used when creating a worktree branch. Leave blank to use the resolved workspace ref or HEAD.
agentConfigHelp.workspaceBranchTemplate: Template for naming derived branches. Supports {{issue.identifier}}, {{issue.title}}, {{agent.name}}, {{project.id}}, {{workspace.repoRef}}, and {{slug}}.
agentConfigHelp.worktreeParentDir: Directory where derived worktrees should be created. Absolute, ~-prefixed, and repo-relative paths are supported.
agentConfigHelp.runtimeServicesJson: Optional workspace runtime service definitions. Use this for shared app servers, workers, or other long-lived companion processes attached to the workspace.
agentConfigHelp.maxTurnsPerRun: Maximum number of agentic turns (tool calls) per heartbeat run.
agentConfigHelp.command: The command to execute (e.g. node, python).
agentConfigHelp.localCommand: Override the path to the CLI command you want the adapter to call (e.g. /usr/local/bin/claude, codex, opencode).
agentConfigHelp.extraArgs: Extra CLI arguments for local adapters, comma-separated.
agentConfigHelp.envVars: Environment variables injected into the adapter process. Use plain values or secret references.
agentConfigHelp.secretAccess: Secrets this agent can reach. Env-var bindings are injected at run start; API-access bindings are fetched on demand via the run-bound agent API and never written to the environment.
agentConfigHelp.bootstrapPrompt: Only sent when Paperclip starts a fresh session. Use this for stable setup guidance that should not be repeated on every heartbeat.
agentConfigHelp.payloadTemplateJson: Optional JSON merged into remote adapter request payloads before Paperclip adds its standard wake and workspace fields.
agentConfigHelp.webhookUrl: The URL that receives POST requests when the agent is invoked.
agentConfigHelp.heartbeatInterval: Run this agent automatically on a timer. Useful for periodic tasks like checking for new work.
agentConfigHelp.timeoutSec: Maximum seconds a run can take before being terminated. 0 means no timeout.
agentConfigHelp.graceSec: Seconds to wait after sending interrupt before force-killing the process.
agentConfigHelp.wakeOnDemand: Allow this agent to be woken by assignments, API calls, UI actions, or automated systems.
agentConfigHelp.cooldownSec: Minimum seconds between consecutive heartbeat runs.
agentConfigHelp.maxConcurrentRuns: Maximum number of heartbeat runs that can execute simultaneously for this agent.
agentConfigHelp.maxTurnContinuationEnabled: Automatically queue bounded continuation runs when an adapter stops because its per-run turn cap was exhausted.
agentConfigHelp.maxTurnContinuationMaxAttempts: Maximum automatic continuations after one max-turn stop. This is separate from max turns per run.
agentConfigHelp.maxTurnContinuationDelaySec: Seconds to wait before starting each max-turn continuation.
agentConfigHelp.budgetMonthlyCents: Monthly spending limit in cents. 0 means no limit.
